analysis: The first actual Unity material import failed with HttpRequestException SSL establishment error, correctly returned the built-in wood fallback, and correctly failed online acceptance. Its raw receipt is preserved as a failure.

A separate later real Unity run, using identical frozen package and harness bytes with unchanged TLS validation, downloaded all four real Poly Haven maps and passed all 19 conditions in 44,418 ms. That run is a retry observation, not a rewrite of the first result.

Later system-curl reachability and differing Python certificate behavior show client/trust-context-dependent observations. The original Unity inner TLS exception and exact failing request URL were not retained in the fallback warning, so neither a permanent CDN outage nor a specific local trust-chain cause is established.
limitations: Only one material and two sequential actual attempts; no CDN availability rate or general reliability claim.
Built-in fallback success does not count as online download success.
Camera.Render evidence in the retry remains a still-image material check, not a general art-quality or Player-build benchmark.
